cleanup.jobPostCleanup: All 14 original logs contain GitHub orphan-process cleanup. This is not promoted to independent proof of every test-owned resource's final state.

warningsBoundary: Node22 compatibility run retains its unsupported Node24 package-engine warning and MaxListenersExceededWarning entries. privacy.resolution: Only an email-regex false positive in a systemd unit filename; no matched value copied into this receipt.
